module purpose: Top-level TRNG IP: accepts bus requests to control and read the generator, instantiates a neoTRNG entropy source and a FIFO buffer, forwards generated bytes into the FIFO, and returns status or FIFO bytes on bus reads.

use-case flows.value: control bits written from the bus into local registers (enable, fifo_clr)
the stored enable bit is delivered to the neoTRNG instance and enables sampling (cell enable chain)
neoTRNG debiasing and sampling assemble debiased bits into an 8-bit sample (sample_sreg), present it on data_o and, when valid, drive FIFO write (wdata/we)
status read: returns enable, FIFO size, simulation flag and fifo.avail
data read: return a random byte from FIFO.rdata when FIFO reports available, otherwise zeros
bus response signalling (ack, err, default data) produced each cycle for requests
registers and internal state forced to known values when rstn_i = '0' (top-level and submodules)

conceptual assets.concept: Sampling enable setting that gates TRNG sampling
conceptual assets.reasoning: A bus write stores the enable bit (bus_access: lines 103-106: 'enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c)'). The top-level 'enable' is a clocked register (reset at line 95) and is connected into the neoTRNG instance (connection at line 137). Inside neoTRNG the input drives sample_en (assignment at line 354) which feeds the cell enable chain (line 311). The module's sampling behaviour and whether entropy is produced and buffered depend on this stored bit, so its integrity is established by these assignments and connections (lines 103-106, 137, 311, 354) and the map records cited below.

conceptual assets.concept: FIFO-clear control decision that empties the FIFO (clear asserted when enable='0' or fifo_clr='1')
conceptual assets.reasoning: A bus write can set fifo_clr (bus_access line 106: 'fifo_clr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_fifo_clr_c)'). The combinational assignment 'fifo.clear <= '1' when (enable = '0') or (fifo_clr = '1') else '0'' (line 170) produces the clear signal that is connected to the FIFO clear input (rnd_pool_fifo_inst.clear_i at line 157). Asserting this control removes buffered entropy from the FIFO; therefore the availability of stored random bytes depends on this decision (lines 106, 157, 170) and the map records cited below.

conceptual assets.concept: Random sample bytes (entropy) produced by neoTRNG and delivered through the FIFO to bus reads
conceptual assets.reasoning: neoTRNG assembles debiased bits into sample_sreg (sampling_control, line 360) and drives it onto data_o (line 366). That output is wired into the top-level FIFO wdata (neoTRNG_inst.data_o -> fifo.wdata at lines 138, 161) and later returned on a bus read from FIFO.rdata when fifo.avail='1' (bus_access lines 114-117). The integrity property that the consumer receives the bytes the TRNG produced is established by these assignments and the instance connections (lines 360, 366, 138, 161, 114-117) and by the map records cited below.

conceptual assets.concept: FIFO availability flag indicating whether buffered random bytes exist
conceptual assets.reasoning: The FIFO's availability signal is sourced from the FIFO instance (connection at line 167) and the top-level read path returns it as a status bit (bus_access line 112) and uses it to select between zeros and fifo.rdata on data reads (lines 114-117). Therefore the integrity of the fifo.avail signal matters to correct readout behaviour and status reporting (lines 112, 114-117) and is established by the connection and gating records cited below.

conceptual assets.concept: Data-ready indicator (valid) produced by neoTRNG that triggers FIFO writes
conceptual assets.reasoning: neoTRNG drives valid_o from the sample counter (valid_o derives from sample_cnt at line 367); that valid_o is wired to the top-level FIFO write enable (neoTRNG_inst.valid_o -> fifo.we, lines 138 and 162) so writes to the FIFO occur when this indicator is true. Corruption of this indicator would cause incorrect FIFO writes or missed samples; the dependency is established by the assignment and instance connections (line 367 and lines 138/162) and the map records cited below.
